value.rationale: Nearly complete local dephasing leaves a rare but physically meaningful subset of complex Haar pure states entangled. The result identifies a sharp fourth-power logarithmic law with leading and next coefficients and a finite-s certified envelope. The logarithm reflects genuine singular product-amplitude statistics, while the Markovian form predicts a nontrivial t exp(-4 gamma t) survivor population. This is a motivated endpoint observable that was only implicitly represented in the primary distribution integral, not an arbitrary slice or a numerical recomputation.
